description: This file defines the 'XMLSchema' class, which parses and manages XML Schema (XSD) documents, providing utilities for schema inspection, serialization, and type handling within a SOAP-based PHP project.

classes.name: XMLSchema
classes.description: A class for parsing, inspecting, modifying, and serializing XML Schema (XSD) documents, supporting complex and simple type definitions, schema imports, and schema serialization.

methods.name: XMLSchema
methods.description: Constructor that initializes schema and XML files, parsing them if provided.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML file given its URI, handling schema or XML content.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses an XML string, setting up the parser with appropriate handlers based on content type.

methods.name: schemaStartElement
methods.description: Handler for start elements during schema parsing, updating internal schema representations.

methods.name: schemaEndElement
methods.description: Handler for end elements during schema parsing, updating the current position and context.

methods.name: schemaCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data within schema elements.

methods.name: serializeSchema
methods.description: Serializes the internal schema representation back into an XML string.

methods.name: xdebug
methods.description: Adds debug information related to schema processing.

methods.name: getPHPType
methods.description: Returns the corresponding PHP type for a user-defined schema type.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a schema type, either complex or simple.

methods.name: serializeTypeDef
methods.description: Serializes a type definition into an XML string (deprecated).

methods.name: typeToForm
methods.description: Generates HTML form inputs for creating instances of a given schema type (deprecated).

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a new complex type definition to the schema.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a new simple type definition to the schema.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element definition to the schema.
